brief: The canvas displays an immersive, deep-tunnel view through an abstract representation of molecular and atomic space. The viewer is carried by an accelerating passage, perceiving complex, brightly colored crystalline structures forming the tunnel walls. As the flow progresses, these crystalline forms periodically fracture and distort, scattering visible, glowing molecular shards. These luminous shards drift away from the main path, following the constant, enveloping movement of the tunnel itself. The entire passage is purely visual, maintaining its dynamic motion regardless of any interaction.
